items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: But Clarence Robertson and all them other guys produced the show.

ctx.x: It was a big break for you.

And then they had this guy, Healy, he was a big shot... See, he got credit for producing the show. But Clarence Robertson and all them other guys produced the show. But he got credit for overseeing it, and he was the producer. And he knew everybody. He used to get more celebrities up there and Sunday night. And I remember this one girl; let's see if I can think of her name now... Helen Morgan. She was up there more than anybody else. I remember her in her days when she was...uh...drank a lot of whiskey. Sometimes…
